skills.name: Temperature Test (深温)
skills.line: Do not enter when it's too hot.
skills.description: Always test the temperature before you enter the pool. Nekogawa splashes spring water at a single target twice, dealing damage equal to 42% of his ATK with each splash.

skills.name: Deluge (泉涌)
skills.description: When an ally passes the Private Pool, they enjoy the healing effect from the hot spring; their HP is recovered by 98% of Nekogawa's ATK and have a 40% chance of having 1 debuff or control effect dispelled from them, prioritizing the control effects. ;Private Pool (別館私湯) : :Located in the fixed position 70%. It is immune to debuffs and control effects. It inherits HP equal to 550% of Nekogawa's ATK and 100% of his DEF, and it cannot take actions. Whenever allies use normal attacks 6 times, and if he is not inflicted with a control effect, the Springwater Cat launches a 6-strike attack on random enemies, dealing damage equal to 125% of Nekogawa's ATK with each strike without triggering the enemies' soul effects, and then summons the Private Pool again. :''(Uses ally summon spot.)''

upgrades.text: When Nekogawa passes through the Private Pool, the recovered HP for him is doubled.

skills.name: Deep Cleaning (洗筋伐髄)
skills.line: I guarantee you a thorough change... for extra money of course.
skills.description: Nekogawa summons the Private Pool. While the Private Pool is present on the battlefield, increases all allies' normal attack damage by 20%. When he summons the Private Pool again, its HP is recovered to 100% and allows all allies to enjoy the healing effect from the hot spring once again. ; : ;Private Pool (別館私湯) : :Located in the fixed position 70%. It is immune to debuffs and control effects. It inherits HP equal to 550% of Nekogawa's ATK and 100% of his DEF, and it cannot take actions. Whenever allies use normal attacks 6 times, and if he is not inflicted with a control effect, the Springwater Cat launches a 6-strike attack on random enemies, dealing damage equal to 125% of Nekogawa's ATK with each strike without triggering the enemies' soul effects, and then summons the Private Pool again. :''(Uses ally summon spot.)''

upgrades.text: Boost to allies' normal attack damage increases to 35%.
When Nekogawa passes through the Private Pool, he is regarded as having reaching the end of the move bar.
Boost to allies' normal attack damage increases to 50%.
'''Upper Hand''': Automatically uses this skill at the start of battle.
